scientific_integrity.claimed_domain: Only normals with all five coordinates nonzero and exactly two distinct absolute values.
scientific_integrity.limits: The stationary point is a saddle on the full normal sphere by established prior work; only a restricted two-level-path minimum is claimed. No higher-dimensional or general all-normal classification; no claim that numerical checks prove continuum assertions. Historical priority is assessed by best-knowledge comparison, without independent audit.
scientific_integrity.normalization: Intrinsic Euclidean four-volume of the central section of the unit five-cube; normals equivalent up to scaling and overall sign.
scientific_integrity.proof: Convolution/inclusion-exclusion for exact weighted-uniform density, symmetry reduction to full-sphere gradient, exhaustive rational derivative sign analysis with exact Bernstein positivity identities.
scientific_integrity.reproducibility: Standalone verify.py, exact SymPy identities and independent SciPy convex-hull checks.

title: Exact two-level critical-direction census for central sections of the five-cube
